note: émission du 9 février 2023 de 500 M$ d'obligations senior 6,75 % échéant en 2029 ; porteurs non nommés
quote: On February 9, 2023, Micron Technology, Inc. ("Micron") settled its offering of (i) an additional $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.750% senior notes due 2029 (the "2029 Notes") and (ii) $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.875% senior notes due 2033 (the "2033 Notes" and, together with the 2029 Notes, the "Notes")
